== Course of events ==

This event follows directly upon the Witch's death, which came after she tricked Dorothy into losing one of her Silver Shoes; when Dorothy, angered, threw water on the Witch, the Witch melted away, ending her tyranny. With the Witch gone, Dorothy declares the Winkies free from slavery, bringing an end to years of cruel servitude they had endured under the Witch's rule.

Dorothy's declaration marks the formal close of the Witch's dominion over the Winkies, who had lived under her harsh control. The freeing of the Winkies stands as a direct consequence of the Witch's demise, with Dorothy acting to ensure that the cruelty they suffered would not continue in the Witch's absence.

In the aftermath, Dorothy turns her attention to her companions, freeing the Cowardly Lion from his prison once she learns the Wicked Witch has melted.
